_notes.purpose: Query-time expansion only. NOTHING here is ever rewritten in body text.
_notes.why: Swami ji / Gurudev / Sadguru / Guruji are one person (user-confirmed), but हे मेरे गुरुदेव is a bhajan lyric — collapsing the forms in text would corrupt the songs. Rishi ji is a DISTINCT speaker and is never aliased to them.
_notes.glosses: The `glosses` map is appended at rebuild time from the 4,061 Latin parentheticals normalize_text.strip_latin_glosses() captures. It is empty here until the rebuild writes it.

speaker_equivalence.note: One person. PRIMARY_SPEAKER stays 'Swami ji' in metadata; these expand a speaker query only.

distinct_speakers.note: A genuine second speaker (113 SAMBODHAN titles name him). NEVER aliased to Swami ji.
